'''June 2001 Normal tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Normal, Illinois on 20 June 2001. [[Geoff Snider]] won it. It is known from Bradley Augsburger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2491">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-20-kkk3-normal-illinois-6-20-01d2491/ kkk3-normal-illinois-6-20-01], DeckTech (Bradley "BadBrad" Augsburger, 20 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-20-kkk3-normal-illinois-6-20-01d2491/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Geoff Snider]]
